name: Karting Prodigy
description: High raw pace and early hype, but less polished with media.

name: Wealthy Backed Driver
description: Strong sponsor value and easier seat access, with more scrutiny.

name: Late Bloomer
description: Lower starting pace but stronger mentality and long-term growth.

name: Technical Driver
description: Excellent feedback and tire understanding with calmer racecraft.

name: Street Circuit Specialist
description: Fearless around walls, quick on low-grip layouts, and volatile in traffic.

name: Rain Master
description: Dangerous in mixed conditions but less consistent over one lap in the dry.
